sql_templates.description: Fetch latest FII/DII flows, regime, breadth, and index data to understand market context.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_flows AS (SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)),
 latest_regime AS (SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.regime_history)),
 latest_breadth AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM breadth.market_daily)),
 latest_index AS (SELECT * FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod) AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50')
 SELECT lf.trade_date, lf.fii_net_today, lf.dii_net_today, lf.flow_signal, lr.regime, lr.confidence, lb.market_sentiment,
 li.close, li.change_pct, li.trend_signal
 FROM latest_flows lf
 JOIN latest_regime lr ON lf.trade_date = lr.trade_date
 JOIN latest_breadth lb ON lf.trade_date = lb.trade_date
 JOIN latest_index li ON lf.trade_date = li.trade_date;
